jobs.title: Software Engineer C# - Machines industrielles
jobs.description:
Vous aimez voir votre code faire tourner de vraies machines ? Notre client, PME technologique belge active à l'international
, conçoit et fabrique des équipements industriels d'analyse haute précision
. Ses machines associent électronique, mécanique, informatique industrielle, physique et chimie. Dans le cadre du développement de son département R&D, il recherche un(e) Software Engineer qui veut sortir de derrière son écran et travailler au plus près du hardware.

Votre mission

Vous développez et faites évoluer les logiciels qui pilotent les machines
, de la conception jusqu'à la mise en service. Vous comprenez le fonctionnement des équipements, échangez avec les équipes R&D, électronique, mécanique, production et SAV, et traduisez les besoins du terrain en solutions logicielles robustes.

Concrètement, vous allez :
Concevoir, développer et maintenir les logiciels de pilotage des équipements
en C# (.NET)
Développer des interfaces opérateurs en WPF/MVVM
, pensées pour les techniciens qui utilisent les machines au quotidien
Participer aux tests sur prototypes
et à la validation des nouvelles fonctionnalités directement sur les équipements
Diagnostiquer et corriger les anomalies, y compris sur les systèmes installés chez les clients

Contribuer à l'architecture logicielle, aux revues de code et à la documentation technique
Selon vos affinités, prendre part au support IT interne (postes, serveurs, réseau)
Assurer une veille sur l'écosystème .NET et les opportunités liées à l'IA

Votre profil

Bachelier ou Master en informatique, génie logiciel ou équivalent
Au moins 2 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel
Expérience sur des machines, équipements ou environnements industriels
: c'est l'élément clé
Solide maîtrise de C#, WPF/MVVM, SQL et Git
, avec une bonne approche de l'architecture et du debugging
Atouts : TCP/IP, logiciels industriels, instrumentation scientifique, notions d'électronique
Curieux(se), autonome et rigoureux(se), vous voulez comprendre la machine derrière le logiciel et vous êtes à l'aise sur le terrain avec les équipes techniques

Ce qui vous attend

Des projets concrets mêlant software, hardware et sciences appliquées

Une proximité directe avec les produits et leurs utilisateurs
Une formation approfondie et de réelles possibilités d'évolution technique
CDI temps plein, horaires flexibles, 20 jours de congés légaux + 6 extralégaux
Salaire compétitif selon expérience, chèques repas, assurance hospitalisation, assurance groupe et plan cafétéria

Intéressé(e) ? Postulez directement ou contactez Antoine à abo@yellow5.be
/ +32 498 03 46 71.

jobs.title: Software Developer 1694
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Software Developer to join a specialist technology team working on secure, data-driven applications in a highly controlled and security-sensitive environment, in hybrid working model.

The role combines modern web development, Python-based data processing, ETL, SQL, dashboard development and data integration. You will work with both classified and unclassified data sources and collaborate closely with technical teams, stakeholders and senior leadership to deliver reliable, secure and user-focused solutions.

The successful candidate will have strong hands-on experience in JavaScript/HTML and modern frontend frameworks, together with solid Python, .NET and Microsoft SQL capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop, configure and maintain web applications using modern web development frameworks.
Transform, integrate and process data from both classified and unclassified sources into secure web-based systems.
Perform data conversion, preprocessing and transformation using Python APIs and ETL technologies.
Develop and enhance data collection tools in line with stakeholder requirements.
Build and maintain backend services and data-processing pipelines.
Develop data-driven dashboards and visualisations for senior stakeholders using Python and/or Power BI.
Work with large and complex datasets using Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib.
Design and implement data-processing and automation solutions.
Develop and maintain high-quality technical documentation covering code, APIs, service endpoints and system architecture.
Prepare user and training materials to support adoption of developed solutions.
Support security testing, verification and approval activities.
Conduct functional and user acceptance testing with stakeholders to ensure that solutions meet agreed requirements.
Work closely with the Lead Point of Contact and relevant stakeholders to understand requirements and priorities.
Regularly report on project progress, technical issues, risks and potential impacts on delivery timelines.
Provide technical input into project planning and risk management.
Present and brief technical progress, achievements and potential issues to senior technical and organisational stakeholders.
Collaborate effectively with other developers, engineers and project stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Essential Skills & Experience
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in web development.
Strong experience with JavaScript and HTML.
Hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks such as:

React
Vue.js
Angular
Extensive practical experience with Microsoft SQL Server.
Strong practical experience with Python for:
Automation
Data processing
ETL
Data analysis
Experience with Python data libraries such as Pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib.
Experience developing data-driven dashboards for business or senior stakeholders using Python and/or Power BI.
Experience building and maintaining backend services, APIs or data-processing pipelines.
Ability to work with data originating from multiple systems and sources.
Familiarity with Git/version control.
Understanding of Agile development methodologies and project delivery practices.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary team.
Advanced level of English.

Desirable Skills
Practical experience with .NET / ASP.NET.
Experience developing RESTful APIs.
Experience with enterprise ETL and data integration technologies.
Experience working with secure or highly regulated environments.
Experience supporting security testing and system accreditation/approval processes.
Experience working with both classified and unclassified information environments.
Experience presenting technical information and project status to senior stakeholders.

Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology or a related technical discipline.

Key Technologies
Frontend: JavaScript, HTML, React, Vue.js, Angular
Backend & Data Processing: Python, APIs, ETL
Data: Microsoft SQL Server, Pandas, NumPy
Visualisation: Power BI, Matplotlib
Development: Git, Agile methodologies
Additional: .NET / ASP.NET

What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate combines strong software development skills with practical data engineering and analytics experience. You should be comfortable moving between frontend development, backend/data processing and stakeholder-facing delivery.
You will need to be able to take a requirement, understand the underlying data and technical constraints, develop an appropriate solution, test it with stakeholders and clearly communicate progress, risks and outcomes.

Because the role operates in a security-sensitive environment, attention to detail, discretion, structured working practices and a strong understanding of secure development principles are essential.

Security Requirements
Due to the nature of the systems and information involved, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain and maintain the required security clearance.

Benefits:
Competitive Remuneration Package.
Unlimited access to a workplace wellness and support platform.
Continuous learning and career growth opportunities.
Opportunity to work on large-scale core banking systems using modern technologies.
Friendly, collaborative, and professional working environment.

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description:
Title: Senior AI developer

Duration: ASAP - 31/12/2026 (Renewable)

Location: Brussels, BELGIUM

Languages: English, Dutch/French

Work Regime: Fulltime | Hybrid (2-3 days onsite per week)

Job Description
- Roles and Responsibilities
Below you can find the full description:

We are looking for a Senior AI Developer who will take AI solutions from idea and prototype to a scalable, safe and reliable production environment. You will help build hands-on three strategic AI use cases on Microsoft Azure, from development and integration to testing, deployment and monitoring.

The role

You will design and develop generative AI and machine learning solutions with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI and Python. You'll build Python services, REST APIs, integrations, and intelligent automations, and set up RAG, vector search, and enterprise knowledge retrieval. You set up testing, evaluation, logging, monitoring and observability, and automate builds and deployments via Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD. You translate security, privacy, compliance and governance requirements into technical controls and development standards.
You will help bring proof of concepts to production with an eye for scalability, maintainability and cost efficiency, develop reusable components and best practices, and support junior developers through pairing, code reviews and knowledge sharing. You will work closely with business stakeholders, Business Automation Analysts, Product Owners, architects and other developers.

Profile

At least 5 years of experience as a software developer, AI engineer or solution engineer
Proven experience in setting up and industrializing AI solutions in Azure
Strong in Python and software engineering principles (clean code, testing, version control)
Experience with cloud-native integration patterns, identity and access management and integrations with enterprise applications
Independent, takes ownership, formulates technical proposals and communicates clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Pragmatic, critical and result-oriented; takes initiative, challenges existing solutions and consciously opts for manageable, scalable technology with a focus on business value

Must-have:

Microsoft Azure
Azure AI Services & Azure OpenAI
Python · REST API's & integratiepatronen
Git, Azure DevOps & CI/CD
Testing, monitoring & observability

Major plus:

Semantic Kernel of LangChain
Vector databases & RAG · Azure Functions & cloud-native services
MCP en agentic architecturen
Docker, Kubernetes & MLOps
Azure AI Engineer-certificering
